description: This is a minified JavaScript source file that provides Bootstrap v3.3.5's core UI components, such as alerts, buttons, carousels, modals, tooltips, popovers, scrollspy, tabs, and affix. It includes code for handling transitions, event bindings, and DOM manipulations related to Bootstrap's UI elements.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: Handles button toggle states and loading text.

classes.name: Collapse
classes.description: Manages collapsible elements and accordion behavior.

classes.name: Dropdown
classes.description: Manages dropdown menu toggling and keyboard navigation.

classes.name: Modal
classes.description: Controls modal dialog showing, hiding, and backdrop handling.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: Displays small hover tooltips with adjustable placement.

classes.name: Popover
classes.description: Displays popover overlays with content, triggered by various events.

classes.name: Scrollspy
classes.description: Highlights navigation items based on scroll position.

classes.name: Tab
classes.description: Handles tab navigation among different content panels.

classes.name: Affix
classes.description: Fixes elements in place when scrolling past a threshold.

methods.name: emulateTransitionEnd
methods.description: Simulates the end of a CSS transition by triggering transitionend event after a specified duration.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the state of buttons, e.g., loading or reset states.

methods.name: slide
methods.description: Transitions to the next or previous carousel item.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays UI components such as modals, tooltips, or collapse panels.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides UI components such as modals, tooltips, or collapse panels.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles between show and hide states for components.

methods.name: activate(b,d,e)
methods.description: Activates a navigation item or tab.

methods.name: addAriaAndCollapsedClass(a,b)
methods.description: Updates ARIA attributes and collapsed class for collapsible elements.

methods.name: checkScrollbar
methods.description: Detects if the body is overflowing to adjust scrollbar accordingly.

methods.name: setScrollbar
methods.description: Adjusts the scrollbar width when modal is opened.
